units: aggregate prefill / per-user generation, tokens per second
hardware: AMD Strix Halo gfx1151, 128 GB unified memory

workload.prefix: Fixed repeating tokens, identical across concurrent requests.
workload.generation: Greedy, 16-token seed at depth zero; stop IDs count toward 128.
workload.timing: Prefix preparation and snapshot restoration excluded. Requests prefill sequentially; decode runs concurrently.
workload.isolation: No concurrent builds, tests or other model work.

quality.scope: This synthetic speed workload; independent numerical/model checks are retained in quality-qualification.json.

scope.workload: C1 pp2048 at depth4096, AR, Nix release STEP19
scope.scope: Final 2048-token embedding through vocabulary projection; excludes 4096-token preparation, loading and final snapshot restoration.

warm_prefill_control.scope: Three consecutive pairs of fresh C1 sessions in one model process per mode/prompt size. First pair includes first use; the following four repetitions form the warm mean. These are prefill timing controls, separate from the full pp2048/tg128 quality-checked matrix.
